arStrings.szText: You can now fish the waterways of Sanctuary.

First, press {hotkey:SOCIAL_WHEEL} to open the {c_highlight}Action Wheel{/c}. Select {c_highlight}Customize{/c} and navigate to the {c_highlight}Miscellaneous tab{/c}. Select the {c_highlight}Fishing{/c} emote and assign it to an Action Wheel slot of your choice. Afterward, you can {c_highlight}key bind{/c} that slot in the Controls tab in the Options menu.

When near water, press {hotkey:SOCIAL_WHEEL} to open the {c_highlight}Action Wheel{/c} and use the {c_highlight}Fishing{/c} emote, or use your chosen {c_highlight}key binding{/c}, to cast your fishing line.
When you see a {c_highlight}splash{/c} at the end of your fishing line, press {c_highlight}any skill button{/c} to reel in your catch. Archive your fish by consuming them.
By fishing, you may catch fish of different rarities or other surprises.
